name: floating floor: Floating floor fills the hole · 2t at (0, 5, 1)
description:
One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 2 ticks after Start.
Floating floor: 1 cell, starting at (0, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone, Floating floor.

Tick 1: Floating floor moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north.
Tick 2: Floating floor fills the hole and becomes permanent Floor.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
